name: maize_grass_herbicide

source.ed50_rel: [AS] dose relative to the label rate that kills half the susceptible plants; the label rate is set to kill > 95 %.
source.slope: [AS] log-logistic slope (typical herbicide dose-response slopes 2-4, recalled).
source.stage_gdd_full: [AS] weed thermal time since emergence of the label optimum: annual grasses at 3-4 leaves (Samson Extra 6 OD: optimum 3-4 leaves; Swiss technical information: grasses from 2 leaves to tillering), ~300 gdd after emergence.
source.stage_gdd_zero: [AS] grasses past tillering escape (Swiss technical information Samson Extra), ~700 gdd.

source.ed50_rel: [AS] dose relative to the label rate that kills half the susceptible plants; the label rate is set to kill > 95 %.
source.slope: [AS] log-logistic slope (typical herbicide dose-response slopes 2-4, recalled).
source.stage_gdd_full: [AS] weed thermal time since emergence up to which the efficacy is complete.
source.stage_gdd_zero: [AS] thermal time from which the efficacy is zero (large weeds escape).

source.ed50_rel: [AS] dose relative to the label rate that kills half the susceptible plants; the label rate is set to kill > 95 %.
source.slope: [AS] log-logistic slope (typical herbicide dose-response slopes 2-4, recalled).
source.stage_gdd_full: [AS] couch grass should have 4-6 leaves (Swiss technical information Samson Extra), ~300 gdd after the shoots emerge.
source.stage_gdd_zero: [AS] thermal time from which the efficacy is zero (large weeds escape).

source.ed50_factor: [AS] ED50 multiplier of the resistant biotype (target-site resistance gives resistance factors of 10 to over 100, recalled).

source.germ_kill: [AS] share of emerging seedlings killed at full residual activity.

source.max_bbch: [C] Samson 4 SC Gebrauchsanleitung (myagrar.de, 2021-01-29): maize 2- to 8-leaf stage, BBCH 12-18; Samson Extra 6 OD (agrofert.cz, 2018): maize BBCH 12-18.
source.damage_in: [AS] share of the stand lost at the label dose inside the window.

source.max_bbch: [AS] a sulfonylurea grass herbicide is made for maize only: any other crop is never in its safe window (the farmer sprays it on maize only).
source.damage_in: [AS] share of the stand lost at the label dose inside the window.

source.dose_exponent: [AS] crop damage grows with dose^exponent (an overdose hurts more than proportionally).

source: Farm needs (2026-11-10): a nicosulfuron-type post-emergence grass herbicide for maize (ALS, HRAC 2; Samson 4 SC class). Crop window and weed stage from the Samson 4 SC Gebrauchsanleitung; the dose response numbers are [AS].
